judgeAgreement.disagreements: The C1 task (#9) is marked partial. Her message is polite and correct but plain, so partial is defensible. I disagree with the B1 listen pass, which carries a note saying there was not enough English to show more than A2. The question was answered correctly, so it is a plain pass.

findings.title: Office-relevant adult tasks and a trusted band

judge.voice: I would use it again. It treated me like an office person: the Berlin email and the deadline message were things I really write. B1 feels fair, even though I said my English is only working. I was glad it did not make me feel stupid. Two things annoyed me. It asked almost the same question twice about how I learned English, which felt like a template. The advice was also weak. It told me to drop 'then', but I know my bigger problems are articles and prepositions, like 'I am accountant'. And 'low confidence' without a reason does not help me believe it. Still, seven minutes in the evening beats booking a course for 800 CZK. I would tell a colleague to try it, but I would want sharper corrections for Monday.
